concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 (abort on missing required fields) is not referenced anywhere in the implementation plan; the plan provides no task, contract, or test that enforces this requirement.
The plan mentions FR-010 in Phase 2, but FR-010 does not exist in the specification. This introduces an over‑reach element that is not required by the spec.
